verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page says organizations can keep their data out of AI model training by contacting their account manager. A community member who read Otter's privacy statement reports that recordings are used, anonymized, as training data by default, which confirms the vendor discloses training use and that the opt-out is a real control. However, the opt-out is only an enterprise sales-contact arrangement with no documented admin-side enforcement, and the evidence pack says nothing about SOC 2 or HIPAA. missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA/BAA posture, self-serve or admin-enforceable training opt-out documentation, detailed first-party training-use policy text.
